what: footprint-rule endings of a run's deterministic eval-watch flights, measured against the trees' geometry

notes: clearances are to the named tree only, from the drone's centre; 'all' is wood plus leaf cards (what the depth camera sees), 'wood' the opaque triangles (what collides)
'start' is the final pose moved back along its yaw by a full-speed step; the true start and the altitude it had are not recorded

extents and boundary clearances use the band's triangle corners (with altitude in the band) thinned to one per grid cell; excess = circle radius - extent in that azimuth bin, 0-extent bins (nothing there) count the whole radius
mec = minimum enclosing circle of the model's horizontal projection over its whole height (all corners; 'wood' its opaque ones)
